name_disambiguation: C1 is this qualification-stage label, NOT the authors official C1 scene. Candidate engineering reuse scene is B4.
purpose: Compare original PMFS core and ordinary correct dynamic inference in the same native Nav2 system. Not a novel-model victory test. RPSPM remains stopped.
authorization: Upstream reports human conditional simulated closed-loop continuation. This draft does not claim absence of user authorization, and does not itself consume new goals; counts/interface/common input still need actual acceptance. No real flight/new CFD/GPU/paid resources.

budget.replay_interpretation: If conditionally admitted, only reuse frozen B4 plant; native goals are explicitly counted as continuation computation, not silently a second generated physics batch. A new realization is outside this draft.
budget.runtime_storage: verified host share, fresh task-owned subdirectory; keep source/build authoritative in existing isolated workspace, no old asset deletion/relocation. Mapping and write/read/hash ping must pass before creation.
budget.new_build_root_disk_need_bytes: unknown until dependency/profile; no build GO with only206MiB headroom

engineering_pair.source_support: same native occupancy-derived 447 free cells; do not replace by R4 25 points or R2 32 coarse regions
engineering_pair.plant: same one_realization_B4, same actual frame-time table, playback starts frame500; no looping
engineering_pair.wind_in_observation_period: last CFD index10, static; NOT time-varying mechanism confirmation
engineering_pair.wind_permission_primary: both causal local anemometer and same GMRF estimate; useWindGroundTruth false for both; derived common-input parameter mode, original-core PMFS, not unchanged author N0
engineering_pair.historical_GT_mode: frozen N1 B4 useWindGroundTruth true stays archived; if used as diagnostic all arms get same truth field and are marked ORACLE_ONLY
engineering_pair.sensor: same native PID sensor_model30 with correction factors false, rate10; same calibrated unit/response for all. Do not reuse R4 mg/m3 sd=.02 or wind sd=.02. Anemometer historical noise_std=.3, frequency20 requires actual noise law audit.
engineering_pair.search_start: official Initialize startTime, not goal invocation
engineering_pair.success: official posterior variance<1.5; separate location endpoint
engineering_pair.motion: same MovingStatePMFS goal ranking/checkGoal/Nav2 controller and costmap; each arm may adapt its own trajectory, same budgets. No replay of truth-dependent path.
engineering_pair.common_decision_main: minimum posterior Euclidean-risk feasible source action from identical support, computed evaluator only; native Top5 remains auxiliary official metric
engineering_pair.common_stop: same variance or300s timeout; Action/result-based outer guard with separate wall ceiling
engineering_pair.RNG: state/source/plant/sensor/navigation streams isolated; keyed event/pose/time sensor noise scheme must freeze before any new goal, no seed selected after performance
engineering_pair.statistical_unit: one previously inspected B4 plant and two arms; engineering pair only, NOT independent novel-method validation

required_interfaces.input: raw concentration/wind messages + original stamps + receiver TF + candidate support + calibrated plant dynamics
required_interfaces.computation: ordinary B1 stateful source-conditioned physics with nuisance integration under the B4 geometry/outlets/source height and actual sensor response
required_interfaces.output: normalized sourceProbability for all native supported cells; prequential likelihood; state checkpoint
required_interfaces.current: R4 has only periodic2D FV, mg/m3 and25 point support. No accepted B4 physical B1 implementation.

required_interfaces.input: B1 candidate-conditional hit/response predictions for reachable receptor cells under same wind and history
required_interfaces.computation: candidate posterior weighted variation of predicted hit frequency; same meaning as original resultsFirstLevel aggregation
required_interfaces.output: varianceOfHitProb and compatible hitProbability/confidence needed by original exploration/search planner
required_interfaces.current: No ROS/C++ adapter. A sourceProbability topic alone does not drive the existing planner.

required_interfaces.input: shared nav state, pose, clock, source/response maps
required_interfaces.computation: same MovingStatePMFS scoring, goal validation and NavigateToPose action; unmodified native terminal logic
required_interfaces.output: actual route, raw CDR, measurement stops, initialization timestamp and Action result
required_interfaces.current: native system exists and historical B4 result is complete. No current ROS process; independent live acceptance needed before goal.

acceptance_tests: sourceProbability same shape/order/mask/coordinates, finite>=0, sum1, no source label in inference
varianceOfHitProb derived from predictions, finite>=0, not posterior-location variance substituted
native sourceProbability injection actually read by stop/record and relevant predicted variability actually read by chooseGoalAndMove
same causal wind permissions including compile/runtime flags; no /wind_value truth fallback in primary local mode
unit/source/height/outlet/mass/time/response contracts; no artificial periodic wrapping in native House
delayed TF stamp/clocks and playback frame binding, only scoped interface regression not repeat old broad audit
preflight RSS/root/shared-disk/time/guard limits and process ownership
known_implementation_risk: Frozen MovingStatePMFS calculates a distance-weighted evaluation variable then inserts interest into ranking. Preserve baseline behavior; do not silently fix it in one arm or claim scientific innovation. Runtime impact not established by this static check.
independent_validation: Not allocated in this draft. Only B4 single already seen realization is available for pair reuse. New unseen sources/concrete wind histories require qualified plant records and a separately frozen count within authorized future batch; cannot call B4 reuse an independent gain.
decision: NO_GO_NOW_INPUT_AND_INTERFACE; timing arithmetic fits but not an executable qualified comparison
